intro.TrustedMarkup:
Editor support for the .vyx files std/vyx claims.

No program links this module, so a program that uses std/vyx pays nothing for it. A tool finds it beside std/vyx by its name.

sig.TrustedMarkup: gen fn vyrnCompleteVyx(root: String, path: String, line: Int64, col: Int64) -> String

prose.TrustedMarkup: Completion items at 1-based line and col of the .vyx at path: a tag name offers the capitalized sibling components and, for a lowercase prefix, element names; an attribute name offers a component's props or an element's attributes and the directives; @ offers the DOM events. root is the directory the generator was pointed at and path the file, both spelled from the importer. Returns a JSON array of {label, kind, detail, from}, empty where the editor's forward map answers instead.
The Vyrn a tool reads in the component at path: its <script> at the file's own positions, then the view function its <template> compiles to.

sig.TrustedMarkup: gen fn vyrnDefinitionVyx(root: String, path: String, line: Int64, col: Int64) -> String

prose.TrustedMarkup: The definition of the component tag at 1-based line and col of the .vyx at path, as an anchor in //@origin notation: the sibling <Name>.vyx at its first line, for a cursor on <Name or </Name in the template. root is the directory the generator was pointed at. Returns "" anywhere else, or when no such sibling exists.
